name: quantity-calculator
title: Quantity calculator
description: Tell shoppers how many packs a job needs: enter an area or a length and width and a waste margin, and get whole packs rounded up, what they cover and the price.
docs: coveragePerPack is what one pack covers in unit (m2 or ft2); packPrice is in minor units and optional. The shopper types an area or a length and a width, and a waste margin that starts at wastePercent; a blank margin counts as wastePercent, as its placeholder says. Results always round up, and the panel says so. Typing 7,5 or 7.5 means the same, and 1,200 is read the way locale writes it. Every field has a message for a missing, unreadable, zero or too large number; maxArea is the largest believable area. onAddToCart receives the packs: return a promise and the button shows it is working, reject and the shopper is told. calculate.ts holds the arithmetic, counted in whole thousandths, and runs on the server too.
